description: This file defines decorators and classes related to data pipe determinism, non-determinism, validation, and functional API registration within the PyTorch data utilities. It includes class definitions for functional data pipes, determinism control, and decorators for non-deterministic behavior and runtime validation.

classes.name: functional_datapipe
classes.description: Decorator class for defining functional data pipes with optional tracing.

classes.name: guaranteed_datapipes_determinism
classes.description: Context manager to enforce deterministic behavior in data pipes.

classes.name: non_deterministic
classes.description: Decorator class to mark data pipes or functions as non-deterministic, with optional custom logic.

classes.name: runtime_validation_disabled
classes.description: Context manager to disable runtime validation checks.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Allows class instances to be used as decorators or callables, applying non-deterministic behavior or wrapping functions.

methods.name: deterministic_wrapper_fn
methods.description: Wrapper function to enforce determinism based on user-defined logic.
